query_text: Need a web app where I can sell my knitting and sewing patterns as downloadable PDFs — I want to be able to upload the files, set a price, and have buyers get the download link automatically after paying, with a simple storefront listing all my patterns organized by category like hats, sweaters, or bags.

Create a web app for selling and booking tickets to my photography workshops, where people can browse upcoming sessions, see what each workshop covers, pick a date, pay, and get a confirmation — I just want everything in one place so I stop juggling spreadsheets and email threads for every class I run.

Create a storefront web app where motion graphics artists and video template creators can list their files for sale, buyers can preview a short clip before purchasing, and everything is organized into categories like intros, lower thirds, and social media templates so people can find what they need quickly in a desktop browser.

A web app store for sound effects and ambient audio packs where creators can browse by mood or category — like rain, city noise, horror stings — preview a short clip right on the listing, and buy individual packs or bundles, all accessible in a regular desktop browser without needing to sign up just to listen to samples.

Build a web app shop for digital stamps and clipart bundles aimed at crafters, where I can upload PNG and SVG files grouped into themed bundle sets, set a price per bundle, and buyers can check out quickly — I want a simple way to manage what's listed and see which bundles are selling, all from a desktop browser.

Create a tracker web app for running a merch pre-order campaign, where I can list the products I'm selling, collect pre-orders from fans, and then keep track of which orders have been fulfilled and which are still waiting — I want a clear overview of every order's status so nothing gets lost when I'm shipping things out in batches.

Need a web app that helps me organize my food photography shoot days — I want to be able to book a shoot date, then build out a shot list for that session with the recipe name, the angles I need, and any props or styling notes, so I stop losing track of what I planned to shoot and I arrive on the day actually prepared.

Build a booking web app for my drone videography business where clients can request aerial coverage for their event, fill in the location details so I can check if it needs airspace approval, and pick an available date from my calendar — I want the whole intake process handled online so I'm not chasing clients over email for basic info.

Create a web app for personal stylists to run virtual closet audits and book styling sessions online, where a client can fill out a quick form about their wardrobe before the appointment, and the stylist can see all the submissions in one place along with the calendar so scheduling and prep happen without a bunch of back-and-forth messages.

Create a web app for an online dance instructor to manage private lesson bookings and share video feedback with students — clients should be able to pick a time slot, pay, and then submit a practice video after the lesson so the instructor can record a short video response, all handled through the website so nothing gets lost in DMs.

Create a web app for a language tutor to let students book conversation practice sessions, pick a language focus like pronunciation or vocab, and then see a simple progress log that tracks how many sessions they've done and what topics were covered — I want everything in one place in a desktop browser so both the tutor and student stay on the same page.

Create a web app for a book cover designer to manage their commission queue and take in client briefs online — clients should be able to fill out a form with their book title, genre, mood, and any reference images, and the designer can see all open commissions lined up in order with each one's status, so there's no more juggling requests over email.

A booking app for caricature and sketch artists who do live events, where event organizers can find available dates, describe their event type and headcount, and lock in a booking — the app should work well in a desktop browser and let the artist see all upcoming gigs in a simple list with the event details and client contact info.

Need a web app for learning fashion illustration techniques where I can work through lessons step by step, submit my practice sketches to get feedback, and see which skills I've completed and which ones are still left — I want a learning tracker, a place to upload my work, and a way to get critique all in one desktop-friendly site.

Need a web app that's a video editing masterclass site for content creators, where I can sign up, access lessons grouped by skill level, track which ones I've finished, and have a space to take notes per lesson — I want it to be well-organized so I can work through it chapter by chapter in my desktop browser without losing my place.

Build a web app for beginner stop-motion animators that includes short video workshops teaching the basics, a place for members to share their little projects and get feedback from others, and a way to track which lessons you've completed — I want the community and the learning materials in the same spot so people can learn and connect in a desktop browser.

Need a web app for street photography enthusiasts to get mentored learning and portfolio reviews — I want to be able to upload a set of photos, have a mentor leave comments on specific shots, track the feedback I've received over time, and see a history of my portfolio submissions so I can see how my work has improved.

Create a web app that runs daily or weekly hand lettering and calligraphy challenges where people can submit their practice work, see other members' entries, and track a streak of how many challenges they've completed — I want it to feel like a fun skill-building habit tracker with a community feed, accessible right in a desktop browser.

Make a web app for a children's book illustration course that lets students work through lessons, post their artwork at each stage, and leave comments on each other's work — I want a clear lesson list, a way to upload work-in-progress images, and a community feed where everyone can see what others are making, all in a regular web browser.

Build a subscription web app for a documentary filmmaking craft workshop site, where subscribers can access video lessons on topics like interviewing, lighting, and story structure, track which lessons they've watched, and keep a personal notes area — I want a clean lesson library that's easy to navigate in a desktop browser when I'm deep in learning mode.

Create a web app for a digital art zine collective where multiple artists can submit work to each issue, the published zines are saved in an archive you can browse by date or theme, and every piece credits the artist who made it — I want something that feels like a proper publication hub that the whole group can use together in a desktop browser.

An online residency program app for creators, where each cohort of members gets their own discussion space to share work and talk through ideas during the program, and there's a place to see who's in your cohort and what everyone is working on — I want it to feel like a small clubhouse for each group, accessible as a web app in a regular browser.

Create a fan fiction archive web app where writers can post their stories, readers can browse by fandom and genre using community-added tags, and anyone can leave a rating or short review — I want a simple way to discover good fics and a clean reading experience in a desktop browser, with the tagging system making it easy to find exactly the vibe you want.

Make a community web app where viewers can submit their favorite clips from live streams, other people vote on the best ones, and the top-voted clips bubble up to a featured feed — I want it to feel like a crowd-sourced highlight reel where the community decides what's worth watching, all running in a desktop browser.

Make a community web app for indie game developers to post devlog updates as they build their games, celebrate milestones like hitting a demo or finishing a level, and follow other devs' progress in a feed — I want something where small makers can share what they're working on without it feeling like a big social network, just a chill spot for game dev updates in a browser.
